name: Godot Shaders
description: Community shader catalogue for Godot with an explicit per-post licence model including CC0, MIT and GPLv3 shader code.

licence.notice: The site states shader/code snippets use the licence selected by each author. Featured images, screenshots, videos and assets shown with a shader are explicitly outside that shader-code licence. Exact shader licence must be preserved before reuse.

provenance.notes: Community submissions declare that submitted shader code is the author's or otherwise free to share, but exact-post provenance and licence must be reviewed individually.

maintenance.evidence: Official catalogue and licence pages were active and contained current shader submissions when checked.
maintenance.notes: Catalogue activity does not make older shaders compatible with the target Godot renderer/version; validate each selected shader.

compatibility.notes: Renderer/Godot-version and mobile/web performance compatibility are shader-specific.

risk.legalNotes: Mixed per-post licensing; GPL shaders can be incompatible with desired proprietary distribution assumptions. Images/videos/assets illustrating a shader are not covered by the shader-code licence. Prefer CC0/MIT where equivalent and inspect each post.
risk.securityNotes: Shader code can cause GPU/performance instability; review loops, texture access and target-renderer behavior before production use.

assessment.notes: High-value shader discovery surface when exact-post licence and renderer/performance checks are automated; never treat screenshots/assets as reusable because shader code is reusable.

evidence.notes: Official terms describe CC0/MIT/GPLv3 per-submission licences and explicitly exclude featured images/screenshots/videos/assets from the shader-code licence.

publication.notes: Public page must emphasize per-shader licensing and the separate status of illustrative media/assets.
